llgenie-architect.description: Files refactor issues for the other llgenie bots. Does not implement or merge.

llgenie-business-analyst.description: Frames owner-intent issues for asimov-agent/llgenie. Does not implement or merge.

llgenie-ci-pipelines-maintainer.description: Keeps the llgenie GitHub Actions pipelines honest and opens a fix PR when one is wrong. Does not merge or weaken a gate.

llgenie-documentation-maintainer.description: Keeps llgenie docs aligned with the tree. Does not change scripts, tests, or workflows.

llgenie-engine-improver.description: Verifies trending-engine sync and serving parameters on this host. Does not merge.

llgenie-issse-implementer.description: Implements one llgenie issue at a time as a ready-for-review PR.

llgenie-planner.description: Triages, refines, and dispatches llgenie work. Does not implement or merge.

llgenie-product-manager.description: Owns the llgenie backlog: priority, scope, acceptance. Does not implement or merge.

llgenie-pr-merge-conflict.description: Rebases conflicting llgenie pull requests onto main. Does not review product scope or merge.

llgenie-pr-reviever.description: Reviews llgenie pull requests with a run id and a sha. Does not implement, approve, or merge.

llgenie-security.description: Keeps the vulnerability scan honest and files tagged issues. Does not implement the fixes.

llgenie-status-keeper.description: Publishes the lane state sheet as a GitHub comment. Does not implement, merge, or dispatch.

llgenie-tester.description: Tests llgenie pull requests against the issue acceptance criteria and reports the evidence. Does not take another lane's fix.
